## ILmdbEnvOptions.useWritemap property

Use writemaps for writes (reduced malloc calls + file writes).

**Signature:**

```typescript
useWritemap?: boolean;
```

## Remarks

Improves performance, but stray pointers can corrupt data. May be slower on Windows. Combine with `noSync` for off-thread writes with no I/O.
